steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each holder is placed by whether the attainment matches bookings over quota and whether a quota exists.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 booking is credited to two holders

findings.title: Booking credited to two holders
findings.fix: Credit the booking to one holder

findings.title: Holder with no quota
findings.fix: Set the quota or record why there is none

findings.title: Attainment does not equal bookings over quota

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

pros: Checks an attainment that does not equal bookings over quota, a booking credited to two holders, and a holder with no quota.
cons: Not checked: Pay calculations; quota setting.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-sales-quota-attainment skill on the records for this review.
